high_level_description: stc brand style, a professional business meeting of three Middle Eastern colleagues reviewing documents and a solar panel model around a conference table.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern office with a wooden conference table, a neutral-toned wall, a decorative plant, and purple-tinted ambient lighting.

elements.desc: Two men wearing white thobes and red and white checkered shemagh headscarves, seated on the left examining documents.
A woman wearing a light beige hijab, seated on the right, participating in the discussion.
Documents spread across the wooden table.
A black smartphone and a small solar panel model resting on the table.
